conventions.convention: The fraction has k ≥ 1 factors and 1 ≤ p ≤ k independent incidence-vector generators over F₂, with independently specified signs ±1; p = k permits a one-run fraction.
Signed words multiply their signs and take symmetric differences of their factor subsets. H consists of words evaluating to +1; x_A = σx_B corresponds to (σ, A △ B) ∈ H.
Resolution is the minimum factor-subset cardinality among nonidentity defining words, independently of the word's sign.
Coefficient nonidentifiability is asserted for an unrestricted parameter space and a fixed-design error distribution independent of β; the contribution of columns c_A = σc_B depends on σβ_A + β_B.
A foldover stacks the original run table with one transformed copy, retaining multiplicities. J may be empty; complete mirror reversal means J = [k].

load_bearing.statement: For a regular fraction determined by p independent generator equations, |F| = 2^(k−p), |H| = 2^p, and H consists exactly of signed words evaluating to +1 on every run. For all factor subsets A,B and σ ∈ {−1,+1}, x_A = σx_B on F if and only if (σ, A △ B) ∈ H.

Independent binary incidence-vector generators and chosen signs specify a regular fraction of the full sign cube. Their signed words generate H; signed aliases are equal or opposite restricted columns, and resolution is the shortest nonidentity defining-word length.

Stacking F and its reversal on J leaves exactly H_J = {(ε,A) ∈ H : |A ∩ J| is even}. An originally signed-aliased pair A,B remains signed-aliased exactly when |(A △ B) ∩ J| is even. Complete mirror foldover separates opposite-order-parity aliases and retains same-parity relations.

For distinct columns c_A = σc_B in an unrestricted fixed-design linear model whose error law is independent of β, their contribution depends only on σβ_A + β_B, and neither coefficient is separately identifiable. Additional runs can remove this ambiguity only if they break the column relation.

published_dependencies.used_for: Checked the full-factorial prerequisite's use of the standard real coordinate pairing as a finite sum of coordinate products.
Checked the full-factorial prerequisite's interpretation of distinct contrast columns as orthogonal when their inner product vanishes.

seams_checked.note: The regular-fraction definition preserves the supplier's full sign cube, subset-product columns, empty-product intercept, and k ≥ 1 domain. The full-factorial orthogonality result is not incorrectly asserted for restricted fractional columns.

The downstream central-composite definition imports the regular fractional run set and declares its generators and resolution. Its resolution-V convention for the standard second-order fractional construction is consistent with the supplier's resolution definition. Both the definition and page explicitly leave estimability and rotatability to separate checks.
